ui.shared.unified_diff.accessible.role: Review control, status or accessible label
ui.shared.unified_diff.accessible.note: Agents proposal review or git-style diff. Preserve ICU arguments exactly. Profile name and origin trigger are identifiers, not translatable. No changes are applied until Accept succeeds; stale is a refusal, not success.

ui.shared.unified_diff.no_changes.role: Review control, status or accessible label
ui.shared.unified_diff.no_changes.note: Agents proposal review or git-style diff. Preserve ICU arguments exactly. Profile name and origin trigger are identifiers, not translatable. No changes are applied until Accept succeeds; stale is a refusal, not success.

ui.shared.unified_diff.changes.role: Count of change blocks in the diff header
ui.shared.unified_diff.changes.note: ICU plural on {count}; give every CLDR category the language needs, including a singular 'one' arm.

ui.shared.unified_diff.show_unchanged.role: Button that expands a folded run of unchanged lines in a diff
ui.shared.unified_diff.show_unchanged.note: ICU plural on {count} (2 or more in practice, 1 possible). Provide singular agreement in a 'one' arm where the language needs it; languages without plural agreement may keep the plain {count}.

ui.shared.unified_diff.hide_unchanged.role: Button that folds an expanded run of unchanged lines back
ui.shared.unified_diff.hide_unchanged.note: Pair of show_unchanged; same plural rules and word order so the two read as one toggle.

ui.shared.unified_diff.line_added.role: Screen-reader-only prefix read before an added diff line
ui.shared.unified_diff.line_added.tone: Single word or short label followed by a colon
ui.shared.unified_diff.line_added.note: Visually hidden; spoken before the line's own text, which is user content and is not translated. Keep it short and end it the way a label ends in your language.

ui.shared.unified_diff.line_removed.role: Screen-reader-only prefix read before a removed diff line
ui.shared.unified_diff.line_removed.tone: Single word or short label followed by a colon
ui.shared.unified_diff.line_removed.note: Visually hidden; spoken before the line's own text, which is user content and is not translated. Keep it short and end it the way a label ends in your language.
